item.title: SuperTalk Eagle Hour 1/28/2026
item.description: The guys talk former Southern Miss head football coach Todd Monken taking the head coaching job with the Cleveland Browns. Former Southern Miss pitcher and Eagle Hour baseball analyst Daniel Stewart. Plus, Eagle Hour listener Ben Johnson answers Bob and Dima’s call for listeners to give their opinions on air.

item.title: Mississippi House passes bill to require insurers to cover biomarker testing
item.description: The Mississippi House of Representatives unanimously passed legislation Wednesday that would require state-regulated health insurance plans to cover biomarker testing, a technology that helps ensure cancer patients get the correct treatment for the type of cancer they are faced with. item.title: Todd Monken hired as Cleveland Browns head coach
item.description: CLEVELAND (AP) — The Cleveland Browns have hired one of their former coordinators to be the team’s head coach. However, it is not the one some people expected. item.title: T&L Extra: ESPN’s Kyle Peterson On Why Brian O’Connor is Among The Best in College Baseball
item.description: Few know the sport of college baseball better than ESPN’s Kyle Peterson, so getting his insight as we inch closer to Opening Day was a must. Brian Hadad welcomes Peterson to the pod for a great conversation about the sport and about Mississippi State’s upcoming season under Coach Brian O’Connor.
